title: As You Like It
meta_description: Welcome to As You Like It, a 6BR beach retreat near Grayton Beach State Park with Gulf views, 2 living rooms \& vintage charm meets luxury comfort!
description_expanded:
ABOUT THIS HOME: Welcome to "As You Like It," your quintessential beach retreat awaiting your arrival! This charming abode combines the nostalgic ambiance of old 30A with all the modern comforts of a luxury beach house, complete with a tantalizing peek-a-boo view of the Gulf of Mexico. Tucked away amidst the rolling sand dunes, adjacent to Grayton Beach State Park, prepare to be transported back in time as you take in sweeping vistas of pristine, untouched white sands. Designed to accommodate multi-generational families, "As You Like It" offers a sanctuary where cherished memories are born. Boasting six bedrooms and four bathrooms, along with a cozy bunk area for the kids to unwind, there's ample space for everyone to spread out and relax. Step outside onto the expansive deck spaces and immerse yourself in the laid-back atmosphere of old 30A, with Grayton Beach State Park just a stone's throw away, offering endless opportunities for exploration and enjoyment. Gather your loved ones and embark on a journey to relive the timeless charm of a traditional beach home at "As You Like It." Whether it's a family vacation or a long-awaited reunion, this idyllic retreat promises to delight guests of all ages, ensuring an unforgettable experience for everyone involved.

ABOUT THE AREA: The best of both worlds: be on the Gulf, walkable to the famous Red Bar (wait for the buzzer while relaxing on the covered porch) or Western Lake for paddle boarding. And if shopping is your thing, you have plenty in Grayton Beach, Seaside and Watercolor as well as farmers markets in both Watercolor and Seaside.

BEACH ACCESS: Beach Access is just a few steps south of the home. No parking available. Grayton Dunes is another beach access close to home a block from the home. When you get to the end of your road, beach access is to the right. No Parking Available. Grayton Beach State Park is one of the most beautiful parks in the area. If you want access to winding trails amongst the massive dunes, strolling along a coastal dune lake as well as a stunning beach with all the facilities, then this is a perfect option. There's a small entry fee for day use at 357 Main Park Road, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459

ACCOMMODATIONS:
• Bedroom 1 - 1 Queen
• Bedroom 2 -- 1 Queen
• Bedroom 3 -- 1 Queen - Master Ensuite w/shower
• Bedroom 4 -- 1 Twin w/trundle
• Bedroom 5 -- 1 Queen
• Bedroom 6 -- 1 Full
• Bunk Room -- 2 Twin / Queen Bunks

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• 2 Adult Bikes
• 2 Living Rooms
• 2 Covered Porches
• Outdoor Shower
• Propane Grill
• Smart TVs in all rooms
• Coffee Maker -- drip or traditional
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath
• Starter kit: toilet paper, paper towels, dishwasher and washing machine pods
• Fully stocked kitchen

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.

Parking Details:
- This home includes 2-3 parking spaces with no overflow parking.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
